ablations.lambda_zero: same controller with eligibility lambda fixed to zero from fit onward
ablations.matched_random: assessment-only hash policy with apply probability equal to the locked tune candidate apply fraction
ablations.no_dual: same controller with dual multiplier fixed to zero
ablations.reward_shift_37: fit controller reward sequence cyclically shifted by 37 within each trajectory; model observations remain ordered
ablations.twin_oracle: tune-only duplicate-state H=8 apply-versus-skip rollout used only to validate controller margin sign; excluded from candidate resources and assessment

action_protocol.actionable_rows: local rows 0 through 250; row 251 contributes pre-update loss but neither arm updates
action_protocol.apply: one fixed-rate SGD update on the current Experience
action_protocol.assessment: deterministic greedy action from the locked controller; ties apply

fit_hash.framing: each field is UTF-8 or fixed-width unsigned big-endian as declared, preceded by a uint32 big-endian byte length
fit_hash.integer_conversion: digest is an unsigned 256-bit big-endian integer
fit_hash.opposite_greedy_rule: choose the nongreedy action iff digest_integer < floor(0.2 * 2^256); otherwise choose greedy

action_protocol.fit_tune_assessment_model_initialization: zero weights and zero bias independently for every stream and data seed
action_protocol.skip: no model gradient-coordinate update and no parameter write
action_protocol.tune: deterministic greedy action from the fit-frozen controller; ties apply

anti_leakage: one ordered Experience enters each observe call
pre-update loss is recorded before the action
no replay, minibatch, hidden accumulation, or future target access
fit, tune, and assessment use disjoint data seeds and zero-initialized models
controller weights mutate only in fit
tune produces eligibility and a canonical lock but cannot change candidate hyperparameters
assessment panels and results do not exist before independent lock acceptance
assessment restores the exact locked controller and never updates it
no post-effect changes to streams, seeds, thresholds, endpoints, controls, or gates

assessment.model_initialization: zero independently for every arm, stream, and seed
assessment.paired_execution: candidate and reference consume byte-identical rows in source order

canonicalization.float: finite IEEE-754 binary64 only; JSON decimal round-trip must reproduce the same binary64 value
canonicalization.protocol_digest: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of this machine protocol file
canonicalization.receipt_digest: SHA-256 of canonical payload after removing its own digest field

dual.budget: b_d=min(0.75,max(0,(3*dimensions-8)/(3*dimensions+3))); this is the maximum apply fraction whose declared dense model savings cover eleven compiled-controller scalar operations per row

controller.fit_order: stream_id ascending, then data_seed ascending, then local row ascending
controller.reward: at local row t>0, reward for action t-1 is -loss_context_t - mu*(apply_cost_t_minus_1-b_d)
controller.trace_reset: trace and q_old reset to zero at each trajectory boundary; theta and mu persist across fit trajectories
true_online_sarsa_recurrence: reject immediately if any intermediate is nonfinite
controller.trajectory_finalization: row 251 supplies the terminal reward for row 250 with q_current=0 and gamma=0; no row-251 action occurs

controls.noise_floor: causal running target mean with one scalar state
controls.oracle_feature_sgd: fixed SGD restricted to protocol-declared oracle features; qualification control only

identification: candidate and fixed SGD start from identical zero model state
candidate and fixed SGD consume identical immutable ordered rows
pre-update loss is measured before either action
all candidate actions are deterministic from the locked controller during assessment
the two learner runs are isolated and cannot interfere
assessment data seeds are independent experimental units
estimand.name: paired complete-policy cumulative pre-update loss effect
estimand.scope: the complete policy trajectory, including all parameter carryover; not an isolated-update causal effect
estimand.sign: tau_f>0 and D_seed_f<0 favor the candidate

assessment_mechanism: within at least one qualifying family, candidate loss is lower than both lambda_zero and matched_random with Holm-adjusted p<=0.05 across the eight family-by-ablation tests
candidate loss is lower than always_skip in predictable_noise with Holm-adjusted p<=0.05
reward_shift_37 does not meet the candidate publication gate
assessment_primary: candidate family mean D_seed_f is negative
two-sided paired normal-approximation p value is Holm-adjusted across four families and adjusted p<=0.05
at least one qualifying family is delayed_reward or drift
assessment_resources: candidate model parameter writes <=0.75*reference in every qualifying family
candidate total declared assessment operations <=reference in every qualifying family
candidate peak assessment logical state bytes <=reference+64; assessment stores only three compiled action-margin coefficients
candidate replay bytes=0 and hidden accumulation=false
fit peak logical state bytes <=reference+128 and are reported separately
assessment_temporal: candidate mean adaptation lag <=reference mean lag+2 rows in every qualifying temporal family
candidate mean adaptation lag is strictly lower in at least one qualifying delayed_reward or drift family
control: oracle_feature_sgd cumulative loss < noise_floor cumulative loss in both predictable_noise streams on tune
candidate does not produce nonfinite loss and its declared total operations do not exceed fixed SGD on pure_noise_v4
always_skip is worse than fixed SGD on tune predictable_noise
gates.synthetic_status: candidate only if every primary, temporal, resource, mechanism, control, custody, lock, and validator predicate passes
tune: candidate family mean log loss ratio <0 in at least two families including delayed_reward or drift
candidate model parameter writes <=0.75*reference and total declared operations <=reference in every family
candidate mean loss <lambda_zero and matched_random in at least one family
twin_oracle has at least 128 probes and Wilson-95 lower bound for controller-margin sign agreement >0.50, using z=1.96 and the standard Wilson lower-bound formula
all values are finite and all accounting invariants pass

lock.decision: accepted or rejected before assessment panel materialization
lock.snapshot_restore: assessment reconstructs a fresh zero model and exact locked controller; no fit or tune model weights are restored

power.scope: primary family log-loss-ratio tests only; adaptation, mechanisms, and composite gates are not claimed powered

prng.initialization: first eight bytes, unsigned big-endian, of SHA-256 over uint32-length-framed UTF-8 protocol_id, cohort_id, stream_id, and decimal data_seed
prng.name: SplitMix64
prng.normal_approximation: sum of twelve consecutive uniform53 draws minus 6; no Gaussian library call

resource_accounting.event_count: sum len(unique valid event_indices) over consumed rows
resource_accounting.fit_controller_fields: theta[6],trace[6],mu,q_old as binary64; 112 bytes beyond the model

line_items.controller_action_ops: fit: 6 multiplies+4 adds+1 comparison; tune/assessment: compile delta_theta=theta_apply-theta_skip once, then charge 2 multiplies+2 adds+1 comparison plus 4 loss-context and 2 event-density scalar operations =11 scalar operations per actionable row; fit exploration and matched-random additionally charge one hash and one threshold comparison
line_items.controller_fit_update_ops: charge every multiply, add, comparison, clip, and each of six theta or trace writes in the declared recurrence
line_items.model_forward_ops: dense fixed-SGD comparison: dimensions multiplies+dimensions adds including bias accumulation
line_items.model_gradient_ops: if apply: dimensions multiplies plus one bias-gradient scalar operation
line_items.model_parameter_writes: if apply: dimensions feature-weight writes plus one bias write; if skip: zero; active nonzero-coordinate writes are also reported separately
line_items.model_update_ops: if apply: for every dimension and bias, one learning-rate multiply and one subtraction
line_items.scalar_control_ops: count log1p, min, max, division, comparison, hash, and counter increments separately

resource_accounting.measured_energy: joules remain separate from logical operations
resource_accounting.model_state: dimensions+1 binary64 model parameters for both arms
resource_accounting.assessment_controller_fields: compiled delta_theta[3] binary64 derived from locked theta_apply-theta_skip; 24 bytes beyond the model
resource_accounting.runner_counters: identical external receipt instrumentation for candidate and reference; reported separately from algorithm state
resource_accounting.update_count: one if any model parameter is written for the row, otherwise zero

postimplementation_requirements: no edits to V1-V3 or guard implementations

statistics.holm: sort by raw p then family_order; adjusted_i=max(previous_adjusted,min(1,(m-rank+1)*raw_p_i)); map to original family
statistics.paired_test: for 48 D_seed_f values, mean, sample standard deviation with denominator 47, t=mean/(sd/sqrt(48)), two-sided p=erfc(abs(t)/sqrt(2))
statistics.per_stream_endpoint: sum of 252 finite pre-update half-squared errors
statistics.zero_variance: if sd=0 and mean=0 then p=1; if sd=0 and mean!=0 then p=0 with statistic=sign(mean); direction gate still required

stop_rules: close V4 as NoCandidate before implementation if exact protocol review is not accepted
close V4 if implementation parity or validator review fails
close V4 before assessment if any tune predicate or independent tune-lock review fails
close V4 if the synthetic strict gate fails; no retuning or second assessment
do not materialize real panels unless synthetic status is candidate and a separate review authorizes execution
close V4 if real quality, temporal, resource, statistics, custody, or measured-energy gates fail
never reopen the plasticity guard or reuse V1-V3 mechanisms under aliases
never reuse a V2 energy trace or receipt

common.task_id: the declared segment or episode index only; forbidden from controller context

delayed_reward_v4.equations: 28 episodes of nine rows; cue is one Rademacher draw per episode; phase=t mod 9; features=(cue,phase/8,1[phase=8],1); target=0 for phase<8 and mapping*cue for phase=8; mapping=+1 for episodes 0..13 and -1 for episodes 14..27

event_camera_v4.equations: draw three indices uniformly by floor(64*u), deduplicate, set each to a Rademacher polarity; force feature0 to alternating -1,+1 by row parity; target=mapping*feature0+0.15*z where mapping=+1 before row126 and -1 afterward

feature_relevance_v4.equations: each feature=2*u-1; target=2*x0+0.1*z before row126 and -2*x1+0.1*z afterward

noisy_mnist_v4.equations: label=row mod 2; zero vector; if label1 set indices 377,378,405,406 to1 else set index377 to-1; perform 40 draws of index=floor(784*u) and add one Rademacher; target=(1 if label1 else -1)+0.2*z

piecewise_drift_v4.equations: each feature=2*u-1; coefficient pairs (x0,x1) are (1,-0.75) rows0..83, (-1.5,0.5) rows84..167, and (0.75,1.25) rows168..251; target is the segment dot product+0.1*z

pure_noise_v4.equations: each feature is active with probability0.15 and when active is Rademacher; target is an independent z draw

sparse_predictable_v4.equations: feature0 is always Rademacher; each other feature is active with probability0.15 and when active is Rademacher; target=1.5*x0+0.25*z

stream_protocol.generator_spec_digest_rule: canonical SHA-256 of prng and stream_protocol objects

temporal_metric.adaptation_lag: at each declared change point, baseline is median of the 16 immediately preceding pre-update losses; threshold=1.10*baseline; scan post-change eight-row rolling means and require two consecutive windows <=threshold; lag is the first window start minus change point
temporal_metric.aggregation: per seed take maximum lag across stream change points; per family average stream lags then average seeds
temporal_metric.censoring: if recovery is absent, lag equals rows-change_point; delayed_reward and drift/event boundaries use the same rule

tune.matched_random_probability: arithmetic mean candidate apply fraction over every tune stream and seed, encoded as binary64 and locked
tune.model_initialization: zero independently for every arm, stream, and seed

ablation_execution.reward_shift_37: during its separate fit only, replace the loss_context reward component at row t with the component from row (t+37) mod 252 from the same immutable trajectory; keep the action cost, dual multiplier, rows, model updates, and resource penalty at t; this arm is forbidden from candidate inputs
ablation_execution.twin_oracle: on tune local rows 0,9,...,243, clone the current candidate model before action; branch apply versus skip; run each clone over rows t+1 through t+8 using the same locked greedy controller independently on each branch and no controller updates; utility=sum(skip_branch_pre_update_loss)-sum(apply_branch_pre_update_loss); margin=Q_apply-Q_skip at t; a sign match requires both nonzero and equal sign, while either zero is a mismatch; probes never alter the candidate trajectory
ablation_execution.wilson_lower_95: for n probes and k sign matches, p=k/n and lower=(p+z^2/(2n)-z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z^2/(4n^2)))/(1+z^2/n), z=1.96

independent_recomputation: fit exploration and matched-random hash actions
every pre-update prediction, loss, action, model update, controller reward, trace, theta, and dual recurrence
all tune gates, twin-oracle probes, snapshot fields, and lock digests
assessment actions, cumulative losses, adaptation lags, controls, ablations, operation counts, storage bytes, paired tests, Holm adjustments, and final status
mandatory_rejections: digest drift or missing required arm
nonfinite value or malformed source order
more or fewer than one Experience per observe call
replay, hidden accumulation, minibatch normalization, reshuffling, future-field access, or leaked task_id
plasticity-guard execution or V1-V3 alias reuse
V2 energy reuse or Astral coupling
